text:
Maria: Heads up — noticed a cluster of tenants with +2-3% invoice delta after last night's routing rollout. Looks correlated to sessions that span the hourly epoch boundary.
Kevin: hmm, can you paste an example tenant id + events?
Maria: sure, here's a compressed tail from the ingest:
```
2026-03-21T23:59:59Z tenant=acme session=XYZ tokens=420 route=primary
2026-03-22T00:00:00Z tenant=acme session=XYZ tokens=30 route=fallback
```
Seems like the same session produced two route-attributed events because fallback kicks in at 00:00.
Anya: so we attribute tokens to two different route tags and both end up charged? :thinking_face:
Samir: possible. The ledger joiner currently keys by (tenant, session, epoch) and epochs are hourly. If a session overlaps an epoch boundary and route tag flips, we might emit two aggregation rows and they both get counted downstream.
Kevin: do we have dedupe keys? I thought the post-agg deduper uses event fingerprint + session start-time tolerance.
Maria: dedupe only runs in the preview pipeline; finalizer expects idempotent aggregation windows. This edge case bypasses preview dedupe because the events hit different partitions (epoch-based).
Samir: quick mitigation: extend epoch join window by 2s and prefer the earlier route tag when session ids match. But that risks undercounting genuine route migrations.
Anya: product-wise, we need correctness > small rounding. Customers are seeing visible invoice diffs. We should prioritize a fix that avoids changing semantics mid-month.
Kevin: short-term ops: can we run a backfill that coalesces these split aggregates for the affected hour? I can script a merge on the ledger (group by tenant+session).
Maria: yes, a targeted backfill for that hour range would fix current invoices. Also need a canary to avoid recurrence.
Samir: long-term, proposal: change joiner key to (tenant, session) + watermarking with a 5s grace that allows a cross-epoch merge, then emit to finalizer with a canonical route selection policy (prefer primary unless fallback lasted >30s).
Anya: prefer primary unless fallback exceeds 30s sounds reasonable. We need to document UX: what customers will see if they deliberately migrate routes.
Kevin: operational checklist: 1) run merge backfill for 2026-03-22 00:00-01:00, 2) deploy joiner patch to canary region with 5s grace, 3) monitor invoice-preview diffs and alert on >0.5% surprise per-tenant.
Maria: I'll open a runbook PR for the backfill and schedule the canary.
Samir: dev note: implementation snippet for joiner change (pseudo):
```
// joiner: key by tenant+session
if (event.timestamp <= epoch_end + grace) {
  attach_to_open_group(tenant, session)
} else {
  start_new_epoch_group()
}
// route selection
if (fallback_duration >= 30s) chosen = fallback else chosen = primary
```
Kevin: add metrics: "joiner.split_count" and "joiner.cross_epoch_coalesced" and pipe to console. We'll watch token tallies vs ledger.
Anya: please tag billing.steering for awareness.
billing-bot: FYI — created ticket BILL-3281 for invoice deltas, severity=P2.
Maria: thanks — will post when backfill done. :thumbsup:
